title: console: render the three new flow screen-field keys (numeric bound, help text, lookup target) exactly as the spec declares them — follows objectstack#17306 ruling A
body:
Follows objectstack-ai/objectstack#17306's ruling A (decision batch #120 item 2, 2026-09-12): the flow screen field gains three keys — a numeric bound, help text, and the lookup target object — spelled with the object field schema's own key names (⛔ no screen-local vocabulary), and the ruling's hard condition is that the keys ship WITH their rendering: 「声明即强制」.

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#17306

## What this repo delivers once the spec lands

The console's flow screen dialog renders the three keys exactly as the spec declares them: the bound enforced on the numeric input (and refused on submit with the field named), the help text shown beside the input (not only in the placeholder), and the lookup field resolving its picker from the declared target object. A pin per key on the rendered dialog; a negative control that a screen field without the keys renders as today.

## ⛔ Not this card

The key names and shapes — the spec's; if the spec's landed spelling differs from what this card assumes, follow the spec and ⛔ never add a local alias.
